theme_central: A great divine trial in three acts — the heavenly scene, the historical trial of Musa against Pharaoh (carried by the brave believer from his own family), then the ultimate trial of the hereafter.

branches.title: Opening, heavenly scene
branches.resume: The Book from Allah, the angels bearing the Throne intercede for the believers.

children.t: The Book from Allah, the angels intercede for the believers

branches.title: The disbelievers' call to the Fire
branches.resume: Reminder that they had been warned, scene of the Judgment where Allah alone will judge with full equity.

children.t: The disbelievers' call to the Fire, Allah's sole and equitable judgment

branches.title: The believer from Pharaoh's family
branches.resume: Fate of the ancient, mightier peoples, courageous and unique plea of the believer from within Pharaoh's own circle.

children.t: Fate of the ancient, mightier peoples, Pharaoh orders the killing of the believers' sons
The believer from Pharaoh's family courageously pleads on behalf of Musa

branches.title: Pharaoh and Haman, dispute in Hell
branches.resume: Pharaoh's attempt to "reach" Musa's God, drowning, dispute of the damned.

children.t: Pharaoh orders Haman to build a tower, drowning, fate contrasted with the believer
Dispute between the damned in Hell, patience asked of the Prophet

branches.title: The certain Hour
branches.resume: Baseless dispute over the signs, supplication answered, warning against arrogance.

children.t: Baseless dispute over Allah's signs, the certain Hour
Supplication answered, warning against arrogance, creation in stages

branches.title: Messengers told and untold
branches.resume: Fate of the ancient generations, blessings of livestock, belated faith useless once the punishment is seen.

children.t: Messengers, some told and some not, fate of the ancient generations
Blessings of livestock, belated faith useless once the punishment is seen
